core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mirsad is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Watchtower, lookout, ambush”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mirsad corresponds to the Arabic form مرصاد (Arabic root ر ص د (r-ṣ-d); مِرْصَاد (Mirṣād)). Its core sense is watchtower, lookout, ambush. Mirsad is Arabic مِرْصَاد (Mirṣād) 'watchtower, lookout, ambush', from the root ر ص د (r-ṣ-d). The source gloss 'Guide, Leader' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense.

persian.name: مرصاد

hindi.name: मिरसाद
